datasets.statisticsLimitations: Med_Income is economic-family income, not household income; visible-minority fields refer only to children aged 0–5, not all residents. These incompatible fields must not be used for the app household-income or population-composition charts. Total_Pop applies only to the entire unchanged EDI polygon.
datasets.boundaryNote: Official regional social-planning neighbourhoods, developed with community consultation and based on whole dissemination areas. Names are preserved verbatim; some official names are broad (e.g. Richmond Hill B/C). EDI boundaries cross municipal limits. Keep whole polygons for their total population; if clipping to a city, discard full-area statistics.
datasets.membershipNote: municipalityCode is a primary community/name-based UI assignment audited against CSD boundaries. municipalityCodes adds municipalities sharing at least 1% of the EDI area. This field does not modify geometry or assert EDI follows municipal borders.
